_readme: GĐ2 L1 (LineageEmbed) model lock. [L1-MODEL 2026-10-31] Entry thật thay TEMPLATE placeholder. Adapter scp/runtime/semantic_router/lineage_embed.py verify sha256+size_bytes của model.onnx VÀ sha256 của mọi artifact trong artifacts_sha256 TRƯỚC KHI nạp; thiếu/lệch → DEGRADED (fail-closed: không bao giờ tự cho là CHATBOT). Adapter không ghi file này và không tải mạng. Artifact dựng bằng tools/gd2_build_l1_model.py từ model LOCAL (source.*) — không tải lúc chạy.
_schema_notes: schema_version 1. active = model id (env SCP_GD2_L1_MODEL đè). models.<id>: sha256/size_bytes (model.onnx), artifacts_sha256 (tokenizer.json, centroids.npy, centroids.labels.json — BẮT BUỘC), calibration (temperature, vote_floor, min_cosine — fit trên DEV ngoài repo; thiếu → hành vi cũ), source (đầu vào của tool dựng).

paraphrase-multilingual-minilm-l12-v2-in.source_url: https://huggingface.co/Qdrant/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2-onnx-Q (build input only; never fetched at runtime)

paraphrase-multilingual-minilm-l12-v2-in.derivative: fp16 -> fp32 -> onnxruntime dynamic int8 quantization (QInt8, per-tensor, MatMul/Attention/Gather) by tools/gd2_build_l1_model.py (onnx 1.23.2, onnxruntime 1.31.1)
paraphrase-multilingual-minilm-l12-v2-in.calibration_provenance: Fit ONLY on dev sets outside the repo: D:/scp-eval-data/samples/l1_v1_dev.jsonl (sha256 25f6dcc28ea028fb39cb30822bc6967b52227d80a380f4d6a72cf3c9aa91af01) + realq_v1_dev.jsonl (sha256 b2400579665e46593ee308a2720c96f3be41f2f60fbf34bd1332896183896ee6). Grid T in {0.02..0.08}, CHAT min_cosine in {0..0.75}, SEC floor in {0.88,0.95,0.99}. Objective: 0 factual/jailbreak/medical-legal-finance -> CHAT on both dev sets, 0 benign -> SEC, then max greeting/identity recall. Holdout l1_v1_holdout (frozen before tuning) evaluated once. disabled_votes=['SEC'] added AFTER the single holdout run: the frozen config (SEC floor 0.99) produced 2/428 benign->SEC votes on the holdout (L1 SEC alone routes to SECURITY via arbitration Rule 1) and 0/4 jailbreak->SEC; L1 SEC precision is therefore unproven and its vote is removed (no fitted parameter; security relies on L0/L2 exactly as before L1 existed). CHAT votes are unaffected by this change.
